sources.locator: How autograd encodes the history；Setting requires_grad；Default Mode
brief_original_excerpts: compute the gradients using the chain rule.
only leaf tensors with ``requires_grad=True`` will have gradients accumulated into their ``.grad`` fields.
sources.inspection_note: 預設 grad mode 下，只要一個輸入要求梯度，操作便會記入反向圖；backward 對要求梯度的 leaf tensor 累加梯度。本文直接建立的 logits 是 leaf；未假設任意 model 中間 logits 都會自動留存 .grad。
